artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two nude figures interacting in a natural setting. The illustration features one figure reclining on the ground and another seated on a rock, reaching out to each other. The figure on the left is muscular and on the ground, while the figure on the right appears more feminine and seated on a rock. The background includes elements of nature like trees with detailed leaves, a serpent around a branch, and a bird on a ledge. In the distance, there are small figures and rolling hills under a cloudy sky. The composition is detailed with fine lines depicting textures and forms.

artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The etching depicts two figures with full bodies visible. The person on the left is seated on the ground, turned slightly towards the right, holding an infant. She has her head bowed and a gentle expression. The person on the right is seated, holding a stringed musical instrument. Both individuals are dressed in flowing garments. The background shows a faint depiction of trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Das glückliche Weltalter (The Happy New Age)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a pastoral scene. The scene includes people and animals in a lush environment. In the foreground, young children play near a large tree, while adults work with woodcutting tools behind them. Further back, a child rides a lion ushering cows and goats. The image is in sepia tones, emphasizing the natural subject.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 19.6 × 13.1 cm (7 11/16 × 5 3/16 in.)
sheet: 13.2 cm (5 3/16 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated bearded man shown from the waist up. He is hunched over a book that he appears to have been studying. The man's facial features are defined by a high forehead, a prominent nose, and a long flowing beard. His hair is sparse and gathered towards the back of his head. He is draped in a cloth that wraps around his waist, leaving his upper torso exposed. Nearby, there is a skull resting on the open book he is leaning towards, and another book is partially visible at his feet. Next to the man, a lion is peering intently, positioned slightly lower and behind him. The background suggests a rocky, cave-like setting with a few stray branches and stones littered around.

artworks.title: Saint Joseph in Half-Length, Holding the Christ Child
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper, mounted on an album sheet
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of two figures, showing a full view of an infant and the upper body of an older man. The older man is seated or standing closely, leaning his head against the infant. Facial features of the older man include a prominent forehead, a Roman nose, and a full beard. The infant has a plump face with curly hair and seems to be lying in the arms of the man. Their clothing is not clearly defined beyond shadows hinting at draped fabric. No jewelry is visible. The figures appear to be illuminated from behind or within, as indicated by the line work representing light rays around the infant's head. The background is mainly crosshatched shading, and the scene is within a rectangular frame on aged paper with handwritten notations above and below the engraved area.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed sketch of three figures presented from the waist up. The central figure is a child seated on the woman's arm, with one arm extended towards the man. The man holds the child lovingly on the left, and the woman is on the right. The man has an aged face with a beard, and the woman has delicate features and wears a cloth or veil over her head. They are all draped in flowing garments. The background features simple horizontal lines and textured shading, suggesting an outdoor setting with abstract cloud-like forms. The style is a detailed black and white etching with fine lines capturing the warmth and intimacy among the figures.

artworks.title: The Infant Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cherubic figure resting on a cloud. The image shows a small infant-like being reclined on a cluster of clouds, with rays of light emanating from behind. Surrounding the figure is an oval wreath with leafy patterns. The artwork is detailed and evokes classical imagery from renaissance or baroque styles.

artworks.title: The Circumcision of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures around a central figure holding a baby. Additional figures in the background observe. There are intricate details in the fabric and the figures' expressions show focus and reverence. In the foreground, two cherubic figures are present, one holding a jug and the other near a small cage with a bird. The drawing style is influenced by classical art.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting four people. The central figure is holding a child and is seated, with two other figures positioned closely behind. The central seated person has delicate facial features with eyes directed towards the child on their lap, and their hair is styled up with loose curls. The seated figure on the right has hair tied back and wears a loose-fitting garment, while the figure on the left, an elderly man with a beard, leans in from the background. The child on the lap is nude, with short curly hair, appearing relaxed. In the foreground, another young child stands holding a long staff, partially draped in a cloak. The background features a curtain with vertical folds and a tree with leaves extending outwards. A soft-textured landscape is faintly visible in the background, suggesting an outdoor setting beyond the domestic interior indicated by the drapery. There are no prominent pieces of jewelry or objects being held by the figures other than the staff.

artworks.title: The Body of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure supported by two winged beings. The central figure is in repose, partially draped with cloth, and positioned above a textured circular background. One winged being is behind the central figure, while the other is at the figure's feet. The drawing features fine lines and shading, creating a detailed composition that emphasizes the interaction between the figures. The drawing is enclosed within an oval shape, giving it an intimate feel.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting against a tree trunk. The man has long hair, a beard, and is wearing a draped garment. He is holding a staff and there are two children playing next to him. One child is holding a book, and both are near a curled lion. The background shows trees and foliage.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.description: This is a drawing of celestial beings descending from the clouds, led by an elder figure emitting light. Two male figures below seem emotionally engaged, with one gesturing upwards. The background includes rolling hills and trees, adding depth to the scene. The lines are intricate, conveying movement and drama.

artworks.title: Temporalis Aeternitas [Second Version]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with intricate details. The central figure is draped in a flowing garment, holding a staff. To the left, another figure seems to be making a gesture. The background features large vases with relief sculptures and natural elements. To the right, a cherub-like figure stands on a plinth, looking towards the main figures. The drawing is detailed with emphasis on texture and form, suggesting the use of shading and line work for depth. The environment combines artistic and natural motifs in a harmonious blend.

artworks.title: Temporalis Aeternitas
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30 × 20.2 cm (11 13/16 × 7 15/16 in.), trimmed to or within platemark
artworks.description: Drawing of classical figures among tombs and ruins. The scene includes draped figures gathered around a column with the inscription "TEMPORALITAS AETERNITAS". Detailed renderings of architectural ruins, stone statues, and vegetation in the background. The figures appear engaged in an activity or conversation, with one standing in a commanding posture. The work is executed in fine lines, capturing fabric and stone texture with precision. Themes of time, memory, and antiquity are evoked.

artworks.title: Theseus Finding Aegeus' Arms
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient, overgrown ruin with elaborate architectural and sculptural elements. The image depicts a scene filled with classical architectural motifs such as columns and grand stone structures. These elements are partially covered in foliage, suggesting nature reclaiming the architecture.

artworks.title: Theseus Finding Aegeus' Arms
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical ruins with a large vase and a ceremonial scene. The drawing features a grand urn or vase adorned with intricate relief work set amidst a scene of classical ruins. On the left side, there is a tree with detailed foliage, while a rocky outcropping or large stone block lies nearby. In the foreground, there are figures involved in a ceremonial action, with stone structures and bas-reliefs depicting human forms and mythical creatures visible on the right side.

artworks.title: Rachel Concealing Laban's Idols
artworks.description: The image shows a group in a natural setting. It includes individuals, horses, and other animals in a lively environment. They are engaged in different activities. The background features trees, mountains, and wide landscapes, indicating a rural setting. The use of lines and shading in the drawing adds depth and detail to the scene.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This image depicts a pastoral scene with a family and angels in a tree. There is a donkey carrying a seated figure holding a child, alongside a standing figure walking beside them. They are positioned near a large tree with lush foliage, and cherub-like figures are nestled within the branches of the tree. In the background, multiple animals, likely sheep, are depicted in a pastoral setting. The line work and detail are intricate, capturing the textures of the tree bark and the wool of the sheep. The overall style of the drawing suggests a sense of mobility and journey, underlined by the calm yet purposeful expressions of the figures and the attentive sheep surrounding them.

artworks.title: Shepherd on Horseback
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century (Giovanni Santagostino?),  after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral setting with a high horizon, rolling hills, detailed textures, and shading created by fine lines in an etching style. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of sepia or light brown. In the foreground, there is a flock of sheep, and in the background, a figure is mounted on a donkey holding a shepherd's staff, surrounded by more sheep. In the right, there is a grove of trees, and the left side opens to a distant landscape.

artworks.title: Bacchanal by a Herm
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century (Giovanni Santagostino?), after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with mythological elements. The image depicts a gathering in a natural setting with mythological figures such as satyrs and nymphs. A reclining semi-nude figure is in the center surrounded by lush vegetation and classical style urns or vases. The scene is framed by two leaning trees with detailed branches. The drawing uses strong lines and hatching to create texture and shadow, vividly rendering each element. The scene exudes raw, natural energy mixed with a sense of antiquity and revelry associated with classical myths.

artworks.title: Temporalis Aeternitas [Second Version]
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.description: This is a detailed line drawing depicting a classical scene. The central figure, a muscular bearded man, holds a long staff and interacts with another figure half-crouched beside him. In the background are ornate urns with intricate carvings, possibly showing other figures. To the left are small putti-like figures, one of which appears contemplative. The scene is framed with foliage and draperies, adding to the richness of textures and intricate composition.

artworks.title: Abraham in Aegyptum (Abraham in Egypt)
artworks.artist: Claude Macé, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of animals and people in a pastoral setting. The scene features several sheep in the foreground, some stopping to graze while others appear to be in motion, all beneath the watch of a group on horseback and on foot. The central focus is a rider on a horse, adorned in draped clothing, who seems to be addressing or guiding the other figures. The background portrays a varied landscape with lush trees and distant hills under a sky filled with textured clouds. The style and techniques suggest detailed line work and shading, creating a rich tapestry of textures and forms. The composition balances movement and stillness, providing a dynamic yet tranquil depiction of pastoral life.

artworks.title: Saint  Anthony with the Christ Child
artworks.description: The image shows a child and an adult. The child is being cradled in the arms of the adult, positioned slightly elevated to be at the level of the adult's face. The child's face, seen in profile, features curly hair and a rounded facial structure, with the child leaning forward to touch their nose to the adult's. The adult is shown from the waist up, wearing a simple, voluminous garment that drapes over the shoulders, presumably a robe. The adult's hair is short and closely cropped. No jewelry or objects are visible in their hands. Near the top left of the small inset image, a stylized plant with a prominent flower is depicted. The background of the inset is minimally detailed, with subtle shading indicating texture. This inset is centered within a large blank space, emphasizing the central figures.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a seated figure holding a lifeless body. To the left, another figure is supporting the seated figure. Above them, two angelic figures are in the picture. To the right, two cherubic figures are observing the scene. The drawing is detailed with intricate lines and shading, portraying emotions and symbols. The background includes vegetation and architectural elements.
